title: Woods+
description: Adds New Wood Types to Minecraft
body:
This New Mod Adds TONS of New Wood Types like:
1. Boabab
2. Wysteria
3. Dragon Blood
4. Gleamroot
5. Willow
6. Fungal
7. and Rose
8. PLUS: New Biome Rose Wood Forest
also there may be a bug where the trees generate in water and i dont know how to fix it
Biomes where the Trees Can Generate in:
1.Savanna
2.Meadows
3.Forests
4.Mushroom Flields
